It starts with ONE area on purpose. Whether DACH fits into a single
file is a measurement, not a guess: raw.githubusercontent.com serves
no blob above 100 MB, and bytes per zoom grow by whatever the data
density does (6.4x from z6 to z7 in the bundled overview, measured
2026-09-21). Run the workflow in `plan` mode first; it prints bytes
per zoom and says whether the budget holds. Only then decide whether
this list needs splitting into states, and at which maxzoom.
